title: Module 17 — containerd & OCI
description: Drive the runtime below Docker: install and start containerd, list its namespaces, pull a real OCI image straight into its store, run a container with ctr (no Docker), see a shim but no runc, and read an image manifest as raw JSON. Everything runs on a real Linux VM.

steps.title: Install containerd and meet the three pieces
Pull an OCI image into the store
Run a container with ctr, not Docker
Read the manifest as raw JSON
